MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, with broad participation but mixed cycle signals. Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive (broad strength); VXX (1W: -14.67% | 1M: +9.66%) is in CORRECTION and HYG/LQD (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +0.81%) is rising, while XLY/XLP (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -0.17%) is falling.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear is easing weekly: VXX (1W: -14.67% | 1M: +9.66%) is in CORRECTION, though its positive monthly return keeps the signal mixed. Credit stress is easing as HYG/LQD (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +0.81%) rises, and stocks are recovering versus bonds as SPY/TLT (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.75%) rises.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Tighter at the margin: Dollar Strength (level: 29.5000; 1W: +1.83% | 1M: +2.01%) is ↑ rising and ABOVE TREND. Yield Curve (level: 0.9779; 1W: -2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) is ↓ falling and BELOW TREND; Duration Preference (level: 0.8816; 1W: -1.25% | 1M: -0.34%) is ↓ falling and BELOW TREND.

EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Financials and defensives are firm: XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%), XLP (1W: +2.52% | 1M: +6.54%), and XLU (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +5.74%) are all ABOVE TREND. XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%) is in RECOVERY; with breadth at 11/11 positive and XLK/XLF (1W: -1.52% | 1M: -12.19%) falling, style favors Value over Growth despite Tech’s weekly rebound.

5. US vs Global?
US equities are recovering: SPY (1W: +2.59% | 1M: -2.26%) is in RECOVERY. India is firmer with INDA (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +7.30%) ABOVE TREND, while EEM (1W: +2.68% | 1M: -4.75%) is in RECOVERY and China remains weak with FXI (1W: -4.21% | 1M: -2.28%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Small caps hold up better: IWM (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +0.89%) is ABOVE TREND. Speculation remains soft: ARKK (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -12.49%) and IBIT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -16.42%) are BELOW TREND.

REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial metals and precious metals are weak: CPER (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -7.40%) and GLD (1W: -4.58% | 1M: -7.12%) are BELOW TREND. Copper/Gold (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -0.61%) is ↑ rising and in RECOVERY, a tentative relative improvement not yet reflected in CPER.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy is rebounding short term: XLE (1W: +5.42% | 1M: -2.40%) is in RECOVERY. Oil remains weak with BNO (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -5.86%) BELOW TREND, while natural gas bounces in UNG (1W: +8.56% | 1M: -8.48%), also in RECOVERY.

STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmation is mixed: XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%) is ABOVE TREND, while SPY (1W: +2.59% | 1M: -2.26%) and XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%) are in RECOVERY. No MAJOR divergence across the core ETFs; monitor whether the weekly rebounds broaden into monthly trend improvement.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor financials and broad sector participation, with XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%) and XLI (1W: +2.94% | 1M: +2.94%) ABOVE TREND. Keep a selective stance on growth: reduce exposure to QQQ (1W: +3.63% | 1M: -6.61%), in RECOVERY, while TLT (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -0.32%) remains BELOW TREND.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If broad participation persists, favor XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%), ABOVE TREND.
BEARISH: If Tech’s rebound fades, monitor XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%), in RECOVERY, for renewed weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If the energy rebound extends, monitor XLE (1W: +5.42% | 1M: -2.40%), in RECOVERY.
BEARISH: If metals weakness persists, monitor CPER (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -7.40%), BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Monitor HYG/LQD at 0.7484 (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +0.81%), ↑ rising and ABOVE TREND; SPY/TLT at 9.5033 (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.75%), ↑ rising and in RECOVERY. Also watch XLK/XLF at 2.9018 (1W: -1.52% | 1M: -12.19%), ↓ falling and BELOW TREND, and Dollar Strength at 29.5000 (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +2.01%), ↑ rising and ABOVE TREND.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive. Financials and defensives show relative strength, while the style signal favors Value over Growth. Monitor whether the Tech rebound broadens, as XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%) remains in RECOVERY.
